name: CTP-v1
frozen_commit_label: CTP selected as final method candidate after LoveDA + Vaihingen evaluation; CTP-v1 may not be modified after this record

decision.rationale: CTP is the final method candidate: soft, adaptive, parameter-free, balances supported gain and unsupported preservation. C2 = failure baseline, SCC = global calibration ablation, Guard = hard preservation oracle-like baseline.
decision.vaihingen_status: untouched_external_confirmation (predict hashes frozen before GT read; CTP computed from frozen scores)

model.identity: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 quick-GELU; OpenCLIP/timm converted state_dict

group_a_templates: a region of {class} viewed from above

visual_prototype_construction.source: weakly supervised regions (SAM3 source weak label; Vaihingen: all-positive image-level assumption, no GT-derived weak labels)

scc_formula.support_shift: b(x) = mean_{c in S}[ A_c(x) - T_c(x) ] (arithmetic mean)

ctp_decision_rule.text_confidence: m_t(x) = T_{t*}(x) - T_second(x) (frozen text margin, no tunable parameter)
ctp_decision_rule.preserve_condition: if t* is unsupported AND T_{t*}(x) + m_t(x) > max_{c in Supported} S_c^SCC(x): predict t*
ctp_decision_rule.k6_rule: all supported -> CTP == SCC == C2 (same b(x) subtracted everywhere)

support_definition.supported: class with an existing weakly-supervised visual prototype
support_definition.unsupported: class without a visual prototype; text prototype only

boundary_properties.test_evidence: tests/test_loveda_partial_support.py (11 passed) + partial_support_checks.json on real data

forbidden_modifications: any modification based on any future GT
